addon.name: IS2OR: Channel Integration
addon.description: IS2OR: Channel Integration — integration with other channel app.

queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_sync_history ( `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `platform` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'salla', `job_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `status` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', `attempt_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `success_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `failure_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `completed_at` int(11) unsigned NULL DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `idx_company_channel` (`company_id`, `platform`), KEY `idx_job_id` (`job_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_connections ( `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `platform` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `external_store_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, `external_store_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `sync_mode` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'timeline_release', `allow_product_sync` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y', `allow_inventory_sync` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y', `allow_price_sync` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y', `allow_order_status_sync_back` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y', `last_successful_sync_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `last_error_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `created_by` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `updated_by` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`connection_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_connection` (`company_id`,`platform`,`external_store_id`), KEY `idx_company_platform_status` (`company_id`,`platform`,`status`), KEY `idx_status_sync` (`status`,`last_successful_sync_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_credentials ( `credential_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL, `key_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `encrypted_access_token` mediumtext NOT NULL, `encrypted_refresh_token` mediumtext, `token_expires_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `refresh_expires_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `scopes` text, `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `last_refresh_attempt_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `last_refresh_success_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`credential_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_connection` (`connection_id`), KEY `idx_status_expires` (`status`,`token_expires_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_inventory_outbox ( `outbox_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `product_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `variant_mapping_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `event_source` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `source_order_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `source_webhook_event_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `target_stock` int(11) NOT NULL, `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', `attempt_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `next_attempt_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `last_error` text, `idempotency_key` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`outbox_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_idempotency` (`idempotency_key`), KEY `idx_status_attempt` (`status`,`next_attempt_at`), KEY `idx_company_product` (`company_id`,`product_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_oauth_states ( `state_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `state_token_hash` char(64) NOT NULL, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `platform` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `return_url` varchar(1024) NOT NULL, `requested_by` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `expires_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `used_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`state_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_state_token` (`state_token_hash`), KEY `idx_company_platform_expires` (`company_id`,`platform`,`expires_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_order_mappings ( `order_mapping_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `order_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `platform` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `external_order_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `external_order_number` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, `external_order_url` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL, `source_status` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `source_payment_status` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `source_fulfillment_status` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `last_webhook_event_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`order_mapping_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_connection_external_order` (`connection_id`,`external_order_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_order` (`order_id`), KEY `idx_company_platform` (`company_id`,`platform`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_order_status_outbox ( `outbox_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `order_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `order_mapping_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL, `event_source` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `target_order_status` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `target_shipping_status` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `tracking_number` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `carrier_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `payload_hash` char(64) NOT NULL, `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', `attempt_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `next_attempt_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `last_error` text, `idempotency_key` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`outbox_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_idempotency` (`idempotency_key`), KEY `idx_status_attempt` (`status`,`next_attempt_at`), KEY `idx_connection_order` (`connection_id`,`order_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_product_mappings ( `mapping_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `product_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `external_product_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `external_sku` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `external_updated_at` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `external_admin_url` varchar(1024) DEFAULT NULL, `mapping_status` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `drift_status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', `last_pulled_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `last_pushed_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`mapping_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_connection_external` (`connection_id`,`external_product_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_connection_product` (`connection_id`,`product_id`), KEY `idx_company_product` (`company_id`,`product_id`), KEY `idx_connection_sku` (`connection_id`,`external_sku`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_product_outbox ( `outbox_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `product_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `event_source` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `change_hash` char(64) NOT NULL, `target_action` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', `attempt_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `next_attempt_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `last_error` text, `idempotency_key` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`outbox_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_idempotency` (`idempotency_key`), KEY `idx_status_attempt` (`status`,`next_attempt_at`), KEY `idx_company_product` (`company_id`,`product_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_status_mappings ( `status_mapping_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `platform` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `company_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `cscart_status` char(1) NOT NULL, `provider_order_status` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `provider_shipping_status` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `enabled` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y', `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`status_mapping_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_platform_company_status` (`platform`,`company_id`,`cscart_status`), KEY `idx_platform_enabled` (`platform`,`enabled`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_sync_issues ( `issue_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `platform` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `issue_type` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `severity` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `affected_object_type` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `affected_object_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, `product_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `order_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `message` text NOT NULL, `required_action` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `first_seen_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `last_seen_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `resolved_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `resolved_by` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`issue_id`), KEY `idx_company_status_severity` (`company_id`,`status`,`severity`), KEY `idx_connection_type_status` (`connection_id`,`issue_type`,`status`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_sync_job_items ( `job_item_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `job_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL, `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `object_type` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `object_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, `product_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `order_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `message` text, `payload_hash` char(64) DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`job_item_id`), KEY `idx_job_status` (`job_id`,`status`), KEY `idx_connection_object` (`connection_id`,`object_type`,`object_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_sync_jobs ( `job_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `company_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `job_type` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `lease_owner` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, `lease_expires_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `cursor_json` text, `total_count` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `success_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `warning_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `failure_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `attempt_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `next_attempt_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `safe_error_summary` text, `created_by` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `started_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `completed_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`job_id`), KEY `idx_type_status_attempt` (`job_type`,`status`,`next_attempt_at`), KEY `idx_connection_type` (`connection_id`,`job_type`,`created_at`), KEY `idx_lease` (`lease_owner`,`lease_expires_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_variant_mappings ( `variant_mapping_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `product_mapping_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL, `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL, `company_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `product_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `combination_hash` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `variation_product_id` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `external_variant_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, `external_stock_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, `external_sku` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `last_known_channel_stock` int(11) DEFAULT NULL, `last_inventory_pushed_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `mapping_status` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `updated_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`variant_mapping_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_connection_variant` (`connection_id`,`external_variant_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_connection_stock` (`connection_id`,`external_stock_id`), KEY `idx_connection_product` (`connection_id`,`product_id`), KEY `idx_product_mapping` (`product_mapping_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_webhook_events ( `webhook_event_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `connection_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `platform` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `event_type` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `external_event_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, `external_object_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, `payload_hash` char(64) NOT NULL, `payload_storage` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'db', `payload_json` longtext, `headers_json` text, `signature_valid` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', `processing_status` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `attempt_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `next_attempt_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, `safe_error_summary` text, `received_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `processed_at` int(11) unsigned DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`webhook_event_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_platform_event_id` (`platform`,`external_event_id`), UNIQUE KEY `uq_platform_payload` (`platform`,`event_type`,`external_object_id`,`payload_hash`), KEY `idx_processing_status` (`processing_status`,`next_attempt_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ?:is2or_channel_sync_history;
